form.title: YouTube input
form.description: What this input fetches and how. Everything here belongs to this input alone.
form.channels.title: YouTube Channels and Playlists
form.channels.description: Targets for this input: @handle, channel id UC..., playlist id PL..., or a video. Added to the Url above; duplicates are fetched once.
form.invidious_instances.title: Invidious Instances
form.invidious_instances.description: Mirrors this input resolves streams through, in failover order (at least one).
form.mode.title: Ingest Mode
form.mode.description: recent_uploads reads the newest videos, live_only keeps only the current live stream.
form.max_uploads.title: Max Uploads
form.max_uploads.description: How many recent uploads to take per channel (1 to 15).
form.cache_ttl_minutes.title: Stream Cache TTL (Minutes)
form.cache_ttl_minutes.description: How long this input reuses a resolved stream URL (10 to 360).
